The '''Uba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained five [[Planet/Legends|planets]]: [[Uba I]], [[Uba II]], [[Uba III]], [[Uba IV/Legends|Uba IV]], and [[Uba V]].
